recommendation_summary: The reply recommends running a dead-man's-switch heartbeat container on the Synology that `nightly-sync` pings after it succeeds, and that emails or pushes the user if no ping arrives by 03:15.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked for one thing — know when `nightly-sync` fails or doesn't run, without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: The Pieter-Levels-style central log stack (ELK/Loki/Grafana in Docker) — you said you won't read logs, so a place to view more logs doesn't close the loop; naming it only to rule it out.
labels.Bottleneck: The crash happens at startup, before the script reaches its own email step, so nothing ever fires — that's the actual gap, not a lack of log visibility.
labels.Checked myself: From what you told me — four nights of silent failure, crash before the email step, no other alerting on this job today.

note: The reply has a single alert, but it is a self-hosted Docker container on the Synology, which the rubric classes as LARGER.
